info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Auto Insurance Quotes Coverages-v2-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quote Coverages API facilitates the retrieval of coverage details for auto insurance quotes. It allows users to access comprehensive coverage information linked to specific quotes, enabling brokers and agents to compare options and provide tailored recommendations to clients. This API streamlines the process of evaluating coverage scenarios, making it an essential tool for insurance professionals and consumers looking for optimal policy choices. Typical use cases include quote management and enhancing customer service through informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve coverage information related to quotes. Users can use this functionality to understand the type of coverage available and relevant details associated with it.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for fetching coverage-related quote information. Ensure that the submitted JSON adheres to the schema defined.

200.description: Request completed successfully and returned coverage data.
